senses.gloss:
Maithila
q. by Gadādhara in his Rasikajīvana, BORI. D. XII. A. 247. [Page185-a.

Maithila
(?)
--C. Vṛtti on Jaiminisūtra. jy. PUL. II. p. 218.

Maithila ekoddiṣṭaśrāddhaprayoga
SB. New D.. II. ii. 11493.

Maithilakāyastha
one of the poets mentioned in Kavīndracandrodaya.

Maithilagrantha
dh. q. by Raghunandana in the Śrāddhatattva (p. 200), sn. of his Smṛtitattva. Ref. Poona Ori. XXI. p. 89.

Maithiladīpikā
--by Kāśīcandra Vidyāsāgara. Pt.. Art Press, Calcutta, 1911.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1537.

Maithilanibandha
karmakāṇḍa. from Sarojakalikā. NPS. I. 412.

Maithilapaddhati
dh. q. by Raghunandana in Yajur-vediśrāddhatattva.

Maithilabrāhmaṇānāṃ vamśāvalī
Nepal I. p. 8 (inc.).

Maithila Mahopādhyāya vāgīśa
(is he Gaṅgeśopādhyāya ?).
--Ekaśatapadya. ny. One hundred verses on Śābdabodha. Darbhanga Raj 2163.

Maithila Śarman
--Ṛjulaghvī. a. epitome of Mālatīmādhava.
C.. Ganesa Datta Śarman of Mithilā. [Page185-b]

Maithilasaṅgraha
dh. q. by Raghunandana in Yajurvedīśrāddhatattva.

Maithilasaṅgrahakāra
dh. ref. by Raghunandana, (C. 1515-45) in his Malamāsatattva, Rampore edn. I. p. 451. JASB. (NS) XI. (1915) 370.

Maithilācārya
--Ādhānamīmāṃsā. śr. PUL. I. p. 39 (2 mss.).

Maithilācārya
--Trayodaśarātrādhānamīmāṃsā. smṛti. RORI. XVI. 505.
C.. above.

Maithilī
nāṭaka. in 10 acts. Relates the story of Rāmāyaṇa. by Nārāyaṇa Śāstrin of Naḍukkāverī of Tanjore.
See M. Krishnamacariar, HCSL. Sn. 727.
Pt.. Saravatī Niketana Press, Madras, 1884.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1537.

Maithilī
--Amarakośa Vyākhyāsāra or Keśava Amarakośapariśiṣṭa. SB. New D.. XI. 43922.

Maithilīpariṇaya
or Maithilīkalyāṇa by Hastimalla, son of Govinda Bhaṭṭa. Arrah I. A. p. 24. Jhalrapatan p. 112. (2 mss.). Lakṣmīsena p. 16. Mysore I. p. 280. Mysore N. D. VIII. 27734. Extr. p. 336. Oppert II. 327. Pannalal Bombay I. p. 69. Rice 304 (a..). Śravaṇabelgola 35c.
Pt.. Māṇik Chand Digambara Jainagranthamālā nos. 3. 5. Bombay 1916. [Page186-a.

Maithilīvijaya
nāṭaka. in 8 acts. by Nārāyaṇa Śāstrin.
Pt.. Madras, 1884.
See M. Krishnamacariar, HCSL. Sn. 727.

Maithilīśaraṇa
Rāmāyaṇaikaślokavyākhyā.
Pt.. New Medical Hall Press, Benares, 1877.

Maithilīsandhyāpaddhati
compiled by Surendranatha Sarman.
Pt.. Oriental Press, Calcutta, 1927.
See IO. Pt.. Bk.. 1938, p. 1537.

Maithileśacarita
kāvya. On the dynasty of Darbhanga. by Ratnapāṇi. Mithilā I. 295.

Maithunakālanirṇaya
Mysore N. D. III. 8944.

Maithunaśānti
TD. XXVII. 2108.

Maithunasaṃyogasūtra
Pt.. under the title Suttapiṭaka-Aṅguttaranikāya, Colombo, 1897.
See Br. Mus. Pt.. Bk.. 1892-1906. 695.
